units.name: Militia
units.description: Common folk pressed into service with pitchforks and hope.
units.lore: Farmers with pitchforks and a bell that would not stop ringing. They hold the line because the line runs through their fields.

units.name: Peasant
units.description: Conscript with a hoe, slow and easily spent.
units.lore: Conscripted at harvest with a hoe and a hymn. He was promised the war would be over before the fields needed him.

units.name: Footman
units.description: Shielded soldier that blunts light towers on its own.
units.lore: Drilled until the shield is heavier to drop than to carry. The footman does not break; he is relieved.

units.name: Rifleman
units.description: Sharpshooter with a dwarven rifle and little protection.
units.lore: A dwarven rifle, a flask of black powder and a grudge against anything taller than him. He shoots before the sermon ends.

units.name: Siege Engine
units.description: Plated war machine that crawls forward and refuses to die.
units.lore: Iron, oak and a crew that stopped flinching years ago. It does not storm the gate; it arrives at it and waits.

units.name: Knight
units.description: Plated cavalry that shrugs off light arrows at a canter.
units.lore: Plate forged in the capital, oath sworn in the chapel. He does not stop for arrows; he has stopped for nothing yet.

units.name: Sorceress
units.description: Quick arcane caster with no armor to speak of.
units.lore: Trained in the tower at Dalaran, she can turn a volley into mist. Just not two volleys.

units.name: Gryphon Rider
units.description: Dwarven hammer-wielder on a gryphon, the kingdom's answer from above.
units.lore: A dwarf, a storm hammer and a gryphon that answers to no one else. The sky is the only wall the kingdom could not build.
